title: metadata: every boot of a multi-package artifact built by `os build` warns that its flat `src/docs` pages are "claimed by no package body" — the CLI puts them at the top level by its own rule, and the warning`s remedy cannot be followed
body:
Filing gate: **① product defect with reach measured. Class (b), violates a declared contract.** The producer and the reader of one artifact disagree, and the operator is told to fix something they cannot fix. reach: the boot log of every `objectstack dev` / `start` of a multi-package artifact whose app ships flat `src/docs` pages, measured on every boot.

**Who acts on it:** the objectstack triage seat routes it. The fix lands in the CLI's docs collector and/or the metadata plugin's residual sweep. Found by the `repo:hotcrm` seat's dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1907 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2011), session `session_012zh91QzFgePbkmuHnugLN3`. ⛔ Not a claim. It holds back nothing in hotcrm's code. hotcrm's acceptance for #2011 asks for no ownership diagnostic at boot, so whether to merge with the line present is the hotcrm maintainer's call.

## Measured (hotcrm PR #2011, `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0, `objectstack dev --fresh --seed-admin --compile`)

- Every boot logs one `[MetadataPlugin] … carries N top-level metadata item(s) that none of its 2 package bodies declare …` WARN. The items are hotcrm's four ADR-0046 package docs in flat `src/docs/*.md`.
- **Behaviour equals the single-package main.** The reported owner is the app package `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, and the docs API serves 5 docs on both.
- Boot WARN count: 22 on `main`, 23 on the PR head. The extra line is this one.
- **The remedy cannot be followed in the ADR-0130 layout.** A per-package docs directory must be named after the package id or its last segment (`hotcrm`):
  - `src/sales/docs` gives `docs/uncollected-directory`;
  - `src/service/docs` is collected onto the service body.

  So the app package, whose directory is `src/sales/`, has no docs location the build attaches to its body. An operator or agent following the WARN ("Rebuild the artifact so each collection it ships is carried by the package that owns it") would invent a `src/hotcrm/` directory that ADR-0130's layout does not have.

## Read from source (objectstack `origin/main` `959c209d`)

- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` ~1097–1112: the residual sweep registers top-level items no package body claimed under the manifest id, and warns whenever `residual > 0`.
- The CLI docs collector keeps attaching the flat `src/docs/` directory to the artifact's TOP-LEVEL `docs[]` (`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs*`; its own test reads "keeps reading the flat src/docs/ alongside the per-package ones"). The 2026-09-22 ADR-0130 addendum then leaves exactly those items as residuals.

**Expected (shape for triage, not a spec):** either the build attaches flat `src/docs` to the package that owns the manifest (the app package), or the residual sweep recognises the documented flat-docs rule and stays quiet. In both cases the warning stops telling an author to rebuild something the layout cannot express.

## Duplicate check

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed: "multi-package artifact top-level docs residual warning MetadataPlugin flat src/docs not claimed by any package body" → 31 hits. The nearest are:
- #19525, a docs page restating the package-docs rule;
- #19247, a fixture nesting depth, closed as a duplicate;
- #14512, the double serialization this sweep follows from;
- #14599, top-level attribution.

None reports this warning on a flat `src/docs` artifact.

Dedupe words: flat src/docs residual · top-level metadata item no package body · MetadataPlugin residual warn docs · ADR-0046 package docs multi-package · uncollected-directory app package
